answer: Time-Decay Entropy Ledger forces every agent to ingest a continuously shifting environmental hash, much like a solitary wander tracking an unpredictable atmospheric zephyr. Each valid transaction consumes a cryptographically unique temporal fragment that self-destructs upon broadcast, rendering transaction histories strictly non-transferable between nodes. If an attacker clones an identity to seed a synthetic reef of sybil nodes, the duplicated keys immediately race for the same expiring temporal fragment.
